processing.verification: Read from current reference Settings UI before capture

source.gain: Output Gain normalized .5, displayed -13.98 dB; unity track and master; no normalization
source.wave_mapping: Saw morph w/63; pulse morph (w-64)/63 times .93, pinned to the measured square endpoint at w127
source.level_mapping: OFF=0; nominal middle=10**(-3/20); ON=1. Native middle readback is -3.01 dB; raw per-case readbacks retained, no per-case gain correction.
source.scope: Reference measurements only; no approved target expectations or tolerances
limitations: Reference filter/amplifier remains in output path, maximum cutoff/zero resonance; no true prefilter tap
Free-running phase and noise realization are not matched to DSP or device
No waveform polarity inversion or time reversal during extraction
No per-case gain fitting or waveform refitting

unison_calibration.method: Fit current instance fine response at .49/.51; set one fixed A3 relative unison for catalogue and repeats. No per-case retuning.

source.raw_audio_format: Stereo 32-bit float WAV; 240000 frames per case
source.correction_method: For the two listed A1 narrow-pulse cases, select the fundamental within 2 percent of the known MIDI note instead of the stronger second harmonic. Reconstruct the signed cycle at that fundamental, using the same 64-harmonic, 256-point method. Raw stereo channels were verified identical before copying the corrected channel measurement to both channels.

repeatability.scope: Catalogue plus three same-instance offline captures. Noise-only repeats are exact circular shifts, not independent realizations. Observed spans are not assertion tolerances.
